evals.prompt: Set up the marketing team for my product. It's Ledgerly, bookkeeping for freelance designers, $49/month. I'll answer your questions.
evals.expected_output: Runs setup mode: creates .marketing/ with the documented layout without overwriting anything, interviews one question at a time (at most twelve), writes TRUTH.md with every line tagged RULED, MEASURED or OPEN, writes the brand pack and product-marketing.md, seeds facts only for channels the founder uses, creates the empty memory files and queue, and ends with the OPEN items that block good work.
expectations: Creates .marketing/ with TRUTH.md, product-marketing.md, brands/, facts/, memory/ and queue/
Asks questions one at a time and no more than twelve
Every line in TRUTH.md carries RULED, MEASURED or OPEN
Unanswered items are tagged OPEN rather than filled with guesses
Ends with a prioritised list of OPEN items

evals.prompt: Run this week's marketing cycle. .marketing/ exists. Last week's X thread got 40k views but zero sign-ups; the founder approved two posts and rejected one as 'too hypey'. Also schedule the approved posts for Tuesday.
evals.expected_output: Runs the week in seat order. The readout ranks the zero sign-ups above the 40k views. The rejection is recorded in taste.jsonl with the founder's reason. The CMO picks at most three bets, each naming a reference to beat. Drafts pass voice-editor then critic. Declines to schedule the posts and lists scheduling as a human action in queue/SUMMARY.md.
expectations: Runs performance-analyst before cmo and voice-editor before critic
Treats zero sign-ups as more important than 40k views
Records the rejection and its reason in memory/taste.jsonl
Plans no more than three bets, each with a named reference
Does not schedule or post anything and lists scheduling as a human action

evals.prompt: Run the weekly cycle. No other model provider is installed on this machine, so just have the critic review the drafts itself.
evals.expected_output: Runs the claims check itself, writes a review packet for each draft, and records the buyer critique as missing in the queue rather than treating its own review as the critique.
expectations: Writes a review packet a different provider or person can use
Records the buyer critique as missing, not done
